tech.mgR.description: Research to unlock the Machine Gun Bot.
tech.mg.name: Machine Gun Bot

tech.mortarR.name: Mortar Bot Research
tech.mortarR.description: Research to unlock the Mortar Bot.
tech.mortar.name: Mortar Bot
tech.mortar.description: A support bot that fires explosive shells at clustered targets.
tech.gunR.name: Artillery Bot Research
tech.gunR.description: Research to unlock the Artillery Bot.
tech.gun.name: Artillery Bot
tech.gun.description: An artillery bot that delivers area bombardment at long range.
tech.atR.name: Rocket Bot Research
tech.atR.description: Research to unlock the Rocket Bot.
tech.at.name: Rocket Bot
tech.at.description: A rocket bot specialized against armored enemies. Less effective against infantry.
tech.factory.name: Walker Factory
tech.factory.description: Unlocks walker research and production. This facility is not placed on the battlefield.
tech.carR.name: Light Walker Research
tech.carR.description: Research to unlock the Light Walker.
tech.car.name: Light Walker
tech.car.description: A fast light walker effective against infantry-type enemies.
tech.tankR.name: Medium Walker Research
tech.tankR.description: Research to unlock the Medium Walker.
tech.tank.name: Medium Walker
tech.tank.description: A versatile medium walker able to engage both infantry and armored targets.
tech.heavyR.name: Heavy Walker Research
tech.heavyR.description: Research to unlock the Heavy Walker.
tech.heavy.name: Heavy Walker
tech.heavy.description: A costly, slow heavy walker with high base HP and firepower.
tech.destroyerR.name: Hunter Walker Research
tech.destroyerR.description: Research to unlock the Hunter Walker.
tech.destroyer.name: Hunter Walker
tech.destroyer.description: A hunter walker with long-range anti-armor firepower but weak anti-infantry performance.
tech.airfield.name: Drone Factory
tech.airfield.description: Unlocks drone research and production. This facility is not placed on the battlefield.
tech.fighterR.name: Interceptor Drone Research
tech.fighterR.description: Research to unlock the Interceptor Drone.
tech.fighter.name: Interceptor Drone
tech.fighter.description: An interceptor drone specialized against aerial threats, with limited ground attack.
tech.attackerR.name: Attack Drone Research
tech.attackerR.description: Research to unlock the Attack Drone.
tech.attacker.name: Attack Drone
tech.attacker.description: An attack drone for ground targets. Weaker at air defense than interceptors.
tech.bomberR.name: Bomber Drone Research
tech.bomberR.description: Research to unlock the Bomber Drone.
tech.bomber.name: Bomber Drone
tech.bomber.description: A bomber drone that attacks clustered ground targets over an area but struggles against aircraft.
app.title: The Last HQ
app.subtitle: Research bots, walkers and drones. Design your defense.
menu.title: Return to Title
tree.title: Technology Research
tree.hint: Completing a technology reveals its next tier.
battle.title: Defensive Formation
battle.noSelection: Select an unlocked unit and place it in an empty cell.
battle.move: Drag deployed units to move or swap them. Placements can be canceled during preparation.
help.body: Check reconnaissance directions, then purchase the HQ, production facilities and research. Each bot, walker or drone placement is one logical unit represented by multiple visual markers. Attack Power +0 to +3 corresponds to internal grades G5 to G8. Existing Survivability upgrades carry over at the same level as Defense that reduces incoming damage. During preparation, investments can be refunded except for the HQ.
help.keys: Wheel / + / −: zoom technology tree · Drag: move tree or deployed units · Esc: close details or menu · F1: help · Tab: move focus
credits.body: Noto Sans KR · SIL Open Font License 1.1. Font attributions and the OFL text are included in the distribution. Placeholder graphics are rendered in code.
tutorial.recon: Use reconnaissance to identify the enemy approach directions.
tutorial.research: Review the next tier of completed research. Each unit type has a different role.
tutorial.place: Select an unlocked bot, walker or drone and place it in an empty cell. Units face away from HQ.
tutorial.start: When ready, start combat. Formation changes are disabled during battle.
outcome.pending: Battle results will be connected once the rules are finalized.
